title: Angled Plan View Sample Preparation of Diamond Thin Films for Multiscale Analysis
content: Diamond’s mechanical and electrical properties make it an ideal material for use in extreme environments. It is well-known for its hardness, thermal conductivity (highest of any known material), and chemical inertness. Additionally, it has a band gap of 5.5 eV placing it in the category of ultrawide bandgap materials, which promise to serve as the basis for robust, next-generation electronic devices capable of operating under conditions current devices cannot.
